interfaces: Protocol v7; wire layout, fingerprints, runtime config v2 and public signatures frozen

Leaf ownership is limited to unigame.staticecs.network/Runtime/NetworkServer.cs, unigame.staticecs.network/Tests/Editor/NetworkV7CommandsTests.cs. Aggregate candidate updates only listed gitlinks. Manager records and checks each nested immutable range before review.

DecodeCommands currently sends resync for all failures. Separate packet/envelope framing violations from coordinator resource capacity: malformed framing/schema/session closes only offending peer; TickWindow skips current envelope; coordinator LimitExceeded disposes remaining batch without snapshot resync.

Queue transfers envelope ownership only on Queued; dispose rejected/duplicate and all untransferred scratch envelopes exactly once, including early return. Preserve admitted peers and command ordering.

Existing NetworkSession.Validate allows non-contiguous input sequences; a stale command must not prevent fresh higher-sequence input in the same batch. Test actual dispatch and absence of resync, not only return values.
